messages:
maria: Heads-up  exec wants a single authoritative MVP cut by EOD so we don't drift into a second sprint. I propose: MVP = chat core + embeddings API + minimal SSO stub (feature-flagged). Cut to v1: real-time dashboards, tenant CSV export, advanced RBAC. Anyone strongly object?

devon: No objections. Need to call out infra/security risks for the SSO stub thoughit may still surface a compliance review. I'll map owners+estimates (S/M/L) in a deps doc.

anya: Agree with feature-flagged SSO stub. I'll own the gate: pilot whitelist + required telemetry + rollback plan. Will draft gating doc and share.

sam: If dashboards are deferred we should hide nav items and add an empty-state with "Request access" CTA. I can push a tiny UI patch and copy by tomorrow.

rafael: From perf ops: recommend locking model to 13B-quant for MVP to keep p99 stable. I'll run perf sweeps and post numbers this afternoon. Also recommend disabling nightly large-batch evals in default CI for the launch window.

elliot: Product note: sales has two enterprise pilots asking for tenant export. If we defer, we must provide clear v1 ETA to avoid churn. I'll draft a one-pager for GTM.

maria: Launch criteria we need on the table: p99 chat latency < 750ms, telemetry hooks for errors/latency/token usage, canary with 3 tenants, documented rollback steps, and no open P0 security items. If any of those fail we hold launch.

devon: I'll attach a risk matrix (owner, ETA, effort, blocker) in the decision doc. Posting link shortly.

anya: Gate rules draft: pilot whitelist, required telemetry, manual enable by product, support runbook. Also include acceptance checklist for infra/security.

sam: UI patch ready to review by EOD; includes screenshots and QA steps.

rafael: Perf numbers posted: 13B-quant p50=95ms p95=280ms p99=640ms on staging hw. Adding notes on quality delta vs 30B float.

ops-bot: Reminder: "MVP cut lock" sync tomorrow 09:30 in #all-hands.

maria: Action items: devon = deps/risk matrix; anya = gating + runbook; sam = UI patch; rafael = perf numbers; elliot = GTM one-pager. We'll lock final cut in the 09:30 sync. If anyone can't attend DM me. :thumbsup: 

devon: One more ask  does engineering need any acceptance metrics beyond requests/errors/latency/token cost? If not, we'll keep monitoring minimal for MVP.

maria: Minimal metrics only. All deep analytics and dashboards are v1 work.

elliot: OK, will include v1 ETA in the GTM one-pager and communicate to pilots.

anya: If dashboards are deferred we should log that in the decision doc so downstream teams don't plan around them. I'll add it.

maria: Good. Consensus sounds clear. We'll publish the decision doc after the sync and create a milestone ticket for the MVP cutoff. Meeting tomorrow locks it.
